text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, C, and D at gains felt satisfying, but those sales alone do not show whether I improved my overall account outcome.","My account value has moved up and down despite making no trades in most periods, so I should not treat every short-term change as a reason to act.","I should continue to make deliberate, infrequent decisions based on my portfolio and goals, rather than focusing only on each stock’s gain or loss since purchase."]}
